output.text: {"notes":["Requested readouts are at absolute time t=1.0 s in the world frame: load position in m, swing angle in rad, angular velocity in rad/s, and boundary_crossed as a dimensionless boolean.","The world frame is right-handed with x forward, y left, and z up; positive swing angle displaces the load toward +x.","A scheduled support intervention runs on [0.558, 0.758) s: +0.5277715779308215 m/s² for 0.1 s, then the negative of that acceleration for 0.1 s, after which the support is stationary.","boundary_crossed means the load center of mass crosses x=0.1 m with 0.005 m hysteresis after the observation cutoff at t=0.2 s."]}
